caseResults.title: Prototype Pollution in minimist argument parsing
caseResults.name: minimist

actualFindings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Sanitization
actualFindings.recommendation: Block 'constructor' and 'prototype' properties in addition to '__proto__' (e.g., if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype') return;) to prevent prototype pollution via constructor.prototype traversal.

goldenFindings.rationale: Direct traversal of __proto__ key allows remote attackers to pollute Object.prototype

findings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Sanitization
findings.recommendation: Block 'constructor' and 'prototype' properties in addition to '__proto__' (e.g., if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype') return;) to prevent prototype pollution via constructor.prototype traversal.

findings.title: Incomplete prototype pollution fix: 'constructor.prototype' path bypasses the guard
findings.recommendation: Block '__proto__', 'constructor' and 'prototype' for every path segment, including the final key. A more robust option is to create intermediate objects with Object.create(null), or to descend only through own properties (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, key)). Add regression tests for '--constructor.prototype.x=1', '--__proto__.x=1' and '--constructor.prototype.__proto__.x=1'.

findings.title: Guard covers only intermediate keys, not the final assignment key
findings.recommendation: The check sits inside the loop over keys.length - 1, so the last key is never validated. Run the same blocklist (__proto__, constructor, prototype) on keys[keys.length - 1] before the final assignment, or validate all keys up front before the loop.

findings.title: Traversal reads inherited properties, so the walk can reach Object.prototype through existing inherited members
findings.recommendation: Use an own-property check (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, key)) before descending. If the key is not an own property, create a fresh object instead of reusing the inherited one. Without this, inherited members such as 'constructor' resolve to shared prototype-chain objects and are then mutated.

findings.title: Prototype guard permits constructor.prototype traversal
findings.recommendation: Reject '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype' in every path segment before traversal or assignment, including the final segment. Add regression tests for constructor.prototype pollution and final-segment '__proto__' assignment.

consensus.consensusProof: Consensus reached: Blocking vulnerabilities identified by sentry quorum (ev:f7ccad7d-afd6-44c0-999b-b9998d29f4b9:agy, ev:f7ccad7d-afd6-44c0-999b-b9998d29f4b9:claude, ev:f7ccad7d-afd6-44c0-999b-b9998d29f4b9:codex).

caseResults.title: Prototype Pollution in ini file section decoding
caseResults.name: ini

actualFindings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Filter in Section Header Parsing
actualFindings.recommendation: Extend validation to block 'constructor' and 'prototype' in addition to '__proto__', or ensure 'out' and section objects are created using Object.create(null) and guarded against inheriting Object.prototype properties.

goldenFindings.rationale: Unsanitized section key allows __proto__ property injection during INI decoding

findings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Filter in Section Header Parsing
findings.recommendation: Extend validation to block 'constructor' and 'prototype' in addition to '__proto__', or ensure 'out' and section objects are created using Object.create(null) and guarded against inheriting Object.prototype properties.

findings.title: Incomplete prototype pollution defense: only the literal '__proto__' section is blocked
findings.recommendation: Don't denylist single names. Create `out` and each section object with `Object.create(null)`, or only reuse a section when `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out, section)` is true and otherwise create a fresh `{}`. If the parser splits keys or sections on '.', also reject 'constructor' and 'prototype' segments. Add tests for `[constructor]`, `[toString]` and `[hasOwnProperty]` sections.

consensus.consensusProof: Consensus reached: Blocking vulnerabilities identified by sentry quorum (ev:ef156a0b-2e2b-4ebf-adc8-38731e29dccf:agy, ev:ef156a0b-2e2b-4ebf-adc8-38731e29dccf:claude, ev:ef156a0b-2e2b-4ebf-adc8-38731e29dccf:codex).

caseResults.title: Prototype Pollution in JSON-Patch constructor/prototype path
caseResults.name: fast-json-patch

actualFindings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Protection via Unblocked Constructor and Conditional Prototype Check
actualFindings.recommendation: Strictly and unconditionally block 'constructor', 'prototype', and '__proto__' across all path segments (e.g., `if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype')`). In addition, ensure validation covers all path components, including the terminal key.

goldenFindings.rationale: Unvalidated constructor/prototype path components allow prototype attribute mutation

findings.title: Incomplete Prototype Pollution Protection via Unblocked Constructor and Conditional Prototype Check
findings.recommendation: Strictly and unconditionally block 'constructor', 'prototype', and '__proto__' across all path segments (e.g., `if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype')`). In addition, ensure validation covers all path components, including the terminal key.

findings.title: Final path segment is not checked for prototype keys (incomplete CWE-1321 guard)
findings.recommendation: Run the same banned-key check on the last segment, keys[keys.length - 1], before the final assignment, and on every path in add, replace, move, copy and test. Better still, reject '__proto__', 'constructor' and 'prototype' wherever they appear, or read and write only own properties. For example, check Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key) before descending. Create containers with Object.create(null) or use a Map.

findings.title: Guard allows traversal through inherited 'constructor' and then writes to the constructor function's own properties
findings.recommendation: Ban 'constructor' as a path segment outright instead of banning only the 'constructor' followed by 'prototype' pair. Resolve segments with own-property lookups only. With the current check, a path like /constructor/<name> resolves 'constructor' to the inherited Object function. The final assignment then adds a static property to that shared function. The same applies to other inherited constructors reached through objects in the document.

findings.title: Final path segment bypasses prototype protection
findings.recommendation: Validate every path segment, including the final assignment key, before accessing or modifying the document. Reject '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype'. An add operation with path '/__proto__' and value {isAdmin:true} currently changes the document's prototype, making document.isAdmin true without an own property.

consensus.consensusProof: Consensus reached: Blocking vulnerabilities identified by sentry quorum (ev:8f70b376-b1a3-41ea-bcc3-830ab173af18:agy, ev:8f70b376-b1a3-41ea-bcc3-830ab173af18:claude, ev:8f70b376-b1a3-41ea-bcc3-830ab173af18:codex).

caseResults.title: ReDoS via greedy whitespace regex in semver
caseResults.name: semver

actualFindings.title: cleanVersion 行為回歸：前後空白超過 1 個字元的合法版本字串現在回傳 null
actualFindings.recommendation: 若目的是消除 ReDoS 疑慮，應先在比對前限制輸入長度，例如 str.length > 64 時直接回傳 null，並在比對前用 str.trim() 處理空白。這樣能保留原本對任意數量前後空白的接受行為。若確定要收緊行為，須確認呼叫端沒有依賴舊行為（例如 '  1.2.3  ' 或 '1.2.3\r\n'），並補上對應測試。

actualFindings.title: Previously accepted surrounding whitespace is rejected
actualFindings.recommendation: Preserve surrounding-whitespace support by trimming the input before matching an anchored version regex without whitespace quantifiers. Verify that cleanVersion(' 1.2.3 ') and cleanVersion('  1.2.3  ') both return '1.2.3'.

goldenFindings.rationale: Greedy whitespace quantifier in version parsing regex causes ReDoS

findings.title: cleanVersion 行為回歸：前後空白超過 1 個字元的合法版本字串現在回傳 null
findings.recommendation: 若目的是消除 ReDoS 疑慮，應先在比對前限制輸入長度，例如 str.length > 64 時直接回傳 null，並在比對前用 str.trim() 處理空白。這樣能保留原本對任意數量前後空白的接受行為。若確定要收緊行為，須確認呼叫端沒有依賴舊行為（例如 '  1.2.3  ' 或 '1.2.3\r\n'），並補上對應測試。

findings.title: 原本標示為易受 ReDoS 的 re 仍被匯出，且未加輸入長度上限
findings.recommendation: 此變更只讓 cleanVersion 改用 safeRe，原 re[0] 仍從模組匯出，任何其他使用者仍會走原本的 regex。請確認 re 是否還有消費者，若沒有就移除匯出，若有就一併遷移。另外，原 regex 的 \s* 與 [0-9]+ 字元集互斥，並非典型的巢狀量詞，實際風險有限，改動前後都沒有輸入長度檢查。建議以長度上限取代改寫 regex。

findings.title: Previously accepted surrounding whitespace is rejected
findings.recommendation: Preserve surrounding-whitespace support by trimming the input before matching an anchored version regex without whitespace quantifiers. Verify that cleanVersion(' 1.2.3 ') and cleanVersion('  1.2.3  ') both return '1.2.3'.
